shortDescription: The Viking® 30" Open Burner Gas Range offers professional-grade cooking with powerful burners, providing precise heat control for various cooking techniques. Its high-performance capabilities ensure quick and even heating, making it ideal for both everyday meals and more complex culinary tasks. Durable construction ensures long-lasting reliability.
metaDescription: One of the original open burner ranges provides professional styling and a restaurant caliber burner for exceptional performance. A turn of the knobs delivers 15,000 BTUs of power down to the delicate VariSimmer setting. The large-capacity oven is equipped with a powerful 30,000 BTU u-shaped burner and ProFlow™ Convection Air Baffle to ensure perfectly even heat distribution. And six cooking functions from natural airflow baking to Gourmet-Glo infrared broiling deliver the power for any recipe.

features.text: Commercial-Type Cooking Power
15,000 BTU stainless steel burners with porcelain/cast iron caps
Exclusive! VariSimmer™ setting for all burners
Exclusive! All burners equipped with SureSpark™ Ignition System for consistent and reliable ignition
Automatic re-ignition; surface burners light at any position on the knob and re-light if extinguished even on lowest setting
New - Heavy duty metal knobs with BlackChrome finish shipped standard
New – Larger window opening for better viewing
Exclusive! Combination of single 30,000 BTU U-shaped burner and infrared broiler with SureSpark™ Ignition System
GourmetGlo™ Infrared Broiler provides intense searing heat for broiling applications
Large-capacity ovens with six rack positions (see specifications for oven interior dimensions)
Six functions - natural airflow bake, convection bake, infrared broil, convection infrared broil, convection dehydrate, and convection defrost
All convection functions utilize the ProFlow™ Convection Air Baffle, which is specifically designed to ensure balanced airflow for even heat distribution
Convection fan switch conveniently located on control panel
Two halogen oven lights for excellent visibility throughout the oven cavity
Island trim shipped standard with range
Easy Operation and Cleanup
Removable pull-out drip tray with roller bearing glides for smooth operation
Removable grate supports with separately removable, dishwasher-safe porcelain burner bowls
Burner caps are easily removable for quick cleaning
Heavy-duty, porcelainized, cast-iron removable surface grates provide continuous front-to-rear, left-to-right surface for easy movement of large pots
